title: Renault F1 engine playing God Save the Queen
summary: A short clip of a Renault F1 engine playing God Save the Queen by precisely controlling its RPM, recorded at Goodwood. It demonstrates how finely the drivetrain can be controlled.
why: Treated as a favorite hack and a go-to example in threads about machines playing music.

quote.text: if you haven't heard an F1 car play God Save The Queen [0] it's a great watch
